patterns.interpretation: Identity comes from one authored campaign composition with independent identity, subject, action and control layers; the logo alone is not the stage.
patterns.recommendation: Keep the campaign art dominant and reconstruct every required layer independently around the frozen official hero asset.

patterns.scope: card database search and filtering region

patterns.interpretation: Query entry, categorical filtering, actions and optional complexity form one dense task organism rather than a decorative card grid.
patterns.recommendation: Preserve all groups, their density, action row and disclosure seam as one unit.

patterns.recommendation: Retain tutorial-to-card-to-field progression and visibly couple each annotation list to its specimen.

patterns.scope: 390px behavior across all three page families

informationDensity.recommendation: Do not normalize these page families to one card density; preserve lead mass and order on phone.
